## Experiment

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

translate_unique <- function(from = c("peacock", "dolphin", "dolphin", "bat", "bat", "dog"), 
                             lookup = data.frame(id1 = c("peacock", "dolphin", "bat"),
                                                 id_sp = c("pavo real", "delfín", "murciélago"),
                                                 id3 = c(   NA,    NA, "bunny"),
                                                 .to = c("blue", "turquoise", "black")), 
                             to_column = .to, 
                             missing_value = "grey" |> alpha(.5)){
  
  from_unique <- unique(from)
  
  lookup_long <- lookup |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = -{{to_column}})
  
  data.frame(value = from) |>
    left_join(lookup_long, by = "value") |> 
    pull({{to_column}}) |> 
    replace_na(missing_value)
  
}

translate_unique()


tribble(~animal,
        "dolphin",
        "peacock",
        "peacock",
        "bat",
        "dog",
        "dog") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = animal,
      fill = animal |> translate_unique() |> I()) + 
  geom_bar()


us_map_ref <- usmapdata::us_map() |> rename(.to = geom)

head(us_map_ref)

to_state_geometry <- function(from = c("Texas"), lookup = us_map_ref, to_column = .to, missing_value = NA){
  
  translate_unique(from, lookup, {{to_column}}, missing_value)
  
}

to_state_geometry()

tribble(~state,
        "Texas",
        "Texas",
        "North Carolina",
        "Illinois",
        "California",
        "Argentina") |> 
  count(state) |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(geometry = state |> to_state_geometry()) + # no I() required...
  geom_sf() + 
  aes(fill = n) 


animals_emoji_lookup <- 
  tribble(~en_animal, ~sp_animal, ~.to,
          "peacock",  "pavo real",  "🦚", 
          "dolphin",  "delfín",     "🐬", 
          "bat",      "murciélago", "🦇")
                                          

to_animal_emoji <- function(from, 
                            lookup = animals_emoji_lookup, 
                            to_column = .to, 
                            missing_value = "🤷‍♀️"){
  
  translate_unique(from, lookup, {{to_column}}, missing_value)
  
}


tribble(~animal,
        "dolphin",
        "peacock",
        "peacock",
        "bat",
        "dog",
        "dog") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = animal, y = animal,
      shape = animal |> to_animal_emoji() |> I()) + 
  geom_point(size = 15)


library(tidyverse)
library(deeptime)

df_geopattern <- tibble( 
  id_numerical = c("601", "603", "605"),
  id_name = c("gravel1", "crossbedded gravel", "breccia1"),
  id_name2 = c("gravel", NA, "breccia")) |> 
  mutate(.to = purrr::map(id_numerical, deeptime::geo_pattern))


to_geopattern <- function(from){
  
    translate_unique(from, lookup = df_geopattern, .to, missing_value = NA)

}

tribble(~material,
        "gravel",
        "gravel",
        "breccia") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = material) + 
  geom_bar(color = "green") + 
  aes(fill = material |> to_geopattern())
```
